Perfect! The logs show the issue clearly. The warning shows:

```
skipping annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet on ingress legacy/legacy-portal: Snippet directives are disabled by the Ingress administrator (allow-snippet-annotations=false)
```

This is the root cause! The ingress controller v1.12.1 has `allow-snippet-annotations=false` enabled by default (or was set during the weekend upgrade). This prevents the use of `configuration-snippet` annotations which were likely being used to implement the regex-based redirects.

The Ingress resource was probably using `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet` annotation with nginx rewrite rules to perform the regex capture group redirects from `/old/...` to `/portal/...`, and this annotation is now being skipped because snippet annotations are disabled.

Now I'll update the ticket with this finding and the solution:

input.note:
Root Cause: The nginx-ingress controller v1.12.1 was deployed with `allow-snippet-annotations=false` enabled, which disables support for the `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet` annotation. The legacy-portal Ingress likely uses this annotation with regex rewrite rules to handle the `/old/...` to `/portal/...` redirects using capture groups. The controller logs confirm this: "skipping annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet on ingress legacy/legacy-portal: Snippet directives are disabled by the Ingress administrator (allow-snippet-annotations=false)" [cite: chunk_id from logs].

Evidence: Ingress controller logs (pod ingress-nginx-controller-5c8f9d7b6-qh4tn) show the warning that the configuration-snippet annotation is being skipped. The request to `/old/reports/2024` returns 404, confirming the redirects are not being processed. The legacy-portal pods themselves are healthy and running (2/2 replicas, ready=true, restarts=0).

Solution: The platform team needs to enable snippet annotations on the ingress controller by setting `allow-snippet-annotations=true` in the ingress-nginx controller's configuration/deployment. This will restore support for the regex-based redirects defined in the legacy-portal Ingress resource. Alternatively, if security policies prevent enabling snippets, the team would need to migrate the legacy-portal redirects to use alternative mechanisms (either at the application level or using the limited standard redirect annotations, though these won't support the regex capture groups).
